Make the Z matrix

make_Z.Rd

Make the Z matrix

make_Z(d_pmf, N)

Arguments

N

the maximum MoI

F_moe

the density distribution for a probability mass function

Value

a matrix

Examples

dd = function(x){dpois(x,.2)}
make_Z(dd, 20)
